articles.title: Defence index trades firm in weak market, rises 4% in one week; here's why
articles.summary: On Friday, the Nifty India Defence index defied broader market trends, rising 0.08% as the sole sectoral index in green while the Nifty 50 declined 1%. It rallied up to 4%, showcasing strong investor confidence and the defence sector's resilience. This performance underscores its crucial role in national security and economic growth.

articles.title: PM to visit Assam Saturday, launch Moran ELF & key projects
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to visit Assam on Saturday to inaugurate various development projects. A key launch will be an emergency landing facility (ELF) at Moran, aimed at boosting regional connectivity and strategic infrastructure. This day-long visit underscores the government's focus on enhancing infrastructure and development across the Northeast, signifying significant national progress.

articles.title: AMC's The Vampire Lestat Releases First Ever Rock Single
articles.summary: AMC Networks has launched "Long Face," Lestat de Lioncourt's debut rock single, performed by Sam Reid for the upcoming season of "The Vampire Lestat." This release marks the fictional character's first musical venture, blending the series' supernatural themes with a rock sound. It's a significant event for fans, adding a new dimension to the popular show.
